segments.text: Mu is a self-hosted personal agent with an actual address. You can chat through its web app, email a named agent, or expose the same tool catalog through
MCP, HTTP, and the CLI. One go server covers mail, files, calendars, news, markets, search, and small web apps while letting you bring your own model.
SMTP in, IMAP out, MCP for agents.
